# Drizzle fixtures

Projects read by `test/unit/drizzle.test.js`. `expected/<fixture>.json` is the exact output of `parsers/drizzle.js` with `{ details: true, columnSources: true, git: false }`: it was written by the parser, then checked against the real drizzle-kit, which imports the schema files (DrawMeDatabase only reads them). drizzle-kit 0.31.11 with drizzle-orm 0.45.4 (`drizzle-kit generate`, its JSON snapshot compared table by table) gave, on every fixture but `v1-syntax`, the same tables, columns (order, `NOT NULL`, primary keys), unique columns and constraints, indexes (columns, unique or not, SQL expressions), foreign keys (columns, referenced table and columns, `ON DELETE` / `ON UPDATE`), auto-incremented columns, enum values, lengths, precisions and defaults. `v1-syntax` was checked with drizzle-kit and drizzle-orm 1.0.0-rc.4 (`drizzle-kit export`). drizzle-kit was run on copies of the fixtures, without network access, the packages they import that are not drizzle-orm replaced by stubs; the fixtures themselves are only test data, never run by the tests nor by the extension.

## Real schemas

Copied as they are (text only), from the commit given. The `package.json` of each project is reduced to its name and its `drizzle-orm` and `drizzle-kit` versions (OpenStatus: its `catalog:` versions, as they are). The `drizzle.config.ts` files are copied as they are, except for create-t3-app, whose template is copied where its installer puts it.

| Fixture | Project | Source | License |
|---------|---------|--------|---------|
| `t3/` | create-t3-app, the Drizzle template with NextAuth, PostgreSQL: `pgTableCreator()`, columns written in a callback (`(d) => ({ ... })`), identity columns, composite primary keys | [cli/template/extras/src/server/db/schema-drizzle/with-auth-postgres.ts](https://github.com/t3-oss/create-t3-app/blob/4709861f7e67a15564c0460c13e7b4b6cfcae40d/cli/template/extras/src/server/db/schema-drizzle/with-auth-postgres.ts) as `src/server/db/schema.ts`, [cli/template/extras/config/drizzle-config-postgres.ts](https://github.com/t3-oss/create-t3-app/blob/4709861f7e67a15564c0460c13e7b4b6cfcae40d/cli/template/extras/config/drizzle-config-postgres.ts) as `drizzle.config.ts`, versions of [dependencyVersionMap.ts](https://github.com/t3-oss/create-t3-app/blob/4709861f7e67a15564c0460c13e7b4b6cfcae40d/cli/src/installers/dependencyVersionMap.ts) | MIT ([LICENSE](https://github.com/t3-oss/create-t3-app/blob/4709861f7e67a15564c0460c13e7b4b6cfcae40d/LICENSE)) |

## Hand-made

| Fixture | What it covers |
|---------|----------------|
| `pg-edge-cases/` | PostgreSQL, `casing: 'snake_case'`, the schema folder of a glob (`./src/db/schema/*.ts`): columns without names (drizzle-orm 0.36+), `pgEnum` of an `as const` array and of a TypeScript enum, `pgSchema('auth')` with its table and enum, spreads of an object and of a function of a helper file outside the schema folder, a helper that makes a column, circular references between two files and self references (`AnyPgColumn`), identity columns, arrays of one and two dimensions, every kind of default, `foreignKey()` with its actions, `primaryKey({ columns })` and `primaryKey(t.a, t.b)`, unique constraints and indexes (an SQL expression, a descending column), the extra config as an object, a check constraint, a table creator, a table not exported, a table exported under another name, `relations()`, a view |
| `mysql-edge-cases/` | MySQL, `drizzle.config.json` with two files and `casing: 'camelCase'`: `serial()`, `autoincrement()`, unsigned integers and decimals, `mysqlEnum()` with and without a name, `onUpdateNow()`, JSON and SQL defaults, a `mysqlSchema()` table (not created by drizzle-kit), `mysqlTableCreator()` |
| `sqlite-edge-cases/` | SQLite, code without semicolons, a config object in a variable: `primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true })`, `text({ enum })`, `text({ mode: 'json' })` defaults, `defaultNow()` of integer timestamps, a composite primary key, a self foreign key, `sqliteTableCreator()` |
| `multi-file/` | No `drizzle.config.ts`: the files of `src/db/schema/` (a usual location) with drizzle-orm in `package.json`, an `index.ts` that re-exports tables of a sub-folder (`export *`, `export { a } from`, `export * as`, which drizzle-kit does not read), the path aliases of `tsconfig.json` (`@/db/columns`), a namespace import of helpers (`columns.id()`), a reference through the namespace of the schema (`schema.posts.id`), a view |
| `v1-syntax/` | drizzle-orm 1.0 (1.0.0-rc.4): `snakeCase.table()`, `camelCase.table()`, `snakeCase.schema('audit').table()`, `pgTableCreator(fn, 'snake_case')`, `pgTable.withRLS()`, `.array('[][]')`, `defineRelations()`, and a `casing` in `drizzle.config.ts`, which drizzle-kit 1.0 ignores (a warning) |

To write `expected/` again after a change of the parser, run the parser on each fixture with the options above and check the differences one by one, then against drizzle-kit (`drizzle-kit generate` with a config that sets the `dialect`, the `schema` and the `casing` of the fixture, in a copy of it).
